scope: Conditional inverse boundary design in an existing constant-property synthetic model; no empirical fitting, physical validation, installed pressure specification or guaranteed engineering margin

equations.hydraulic: deltaP=a_i*U_i+0.5*rho*K*U_i^2; a_i=mu*L/wmean_i, raw conservative rectangular Poisson wmean
equations.positive_solution: K=0: use accepted original U exactly; K>0: U=2*deltaP/(a+sqrt(a*a+2*rho*K*deltaP))
equations.thermal: Inherit full-array conjugate finite-fin matrix and backward-Euler transverse-diffusion/axial-advection solver unchanged, replacing only branch mean velocities
equations.branch_pressure: straight friction aU plus illustrative end loss 0.5*rho*K*U^2 equals imposed branch pressure; raw Poisson wall-force balance applies to straight friction, not total pressure when K>0
equations.dissipation: sum(deltaP*Qv); split straight-friction/end-loss; total/60 is omitted mechanical-heating fraction, not electrical fan power

K_interpretation: Uniform nonnegative illustrative end-loss scenarios, not measured uncertainty, fitted hardware coefficients, or resolved entrance/exit/developing flow. Preserve normalized fully developed Poisson profile for thermal advection.

domain.sound_speed_definition: sqrt(gamma*R*T_in_K), gamma=1.4 and R=287.05 J/(kg K); fixed inlet-based conservative diagnostic
domain.pressure_domain_limit: For each mesh/channel, Ulim=min(2300*nu/Dh,0.1*sound_speed/max(normalized_Poisson_shape)); Plim=a*Ulim+0.5*rho*K*Ulim^2; Pupper=min(200,0.999*min(Plim over all active nominal channels)). Explicitly test both conditions before every thermal solve.
domain.on_failure: Retain every K/design and inability to bracket within domain. Never evaluate thermal solution outside domain or relax a tolerance.

mesh_and_roots.primary_root_method: bracket-preserving scipy.optimize.brentq on declared domain endpoints; max 20 iterations; xtol=0.001 Pa, rtol=1e-10
mesh_and_roots.root_bracket: Around returned root evaluate plus/minus 0.002 Pa, doubling halfwidth no more than 8 times while remaining in domain; record signs. Refine with Brent xtol=0.00005 Pa, rtol=1e-12, then evaluate a sign bracket with halfwidth=0.0001 Pa (same bounded widening).
mesh_and_roots.refinement: At each of six main roots evaluate spatial and axial meshes; re-root both meshes beginning at main root +/- 1% (bounded widening to full original domain if necessary), same fine root tolerance and sign-bracket procedure. No outcome-based mesh selection; keep all three roots and discretization differences.

K_checks: K0 reproduces saved accepted 25 Pa nominal and 15 Pa sealed cases for both geometries
Scalar brentq U roots cross-check closed-form positive roots for each distinct channel at P=15,25,domain upper and reported roots
positive K reduces every active flow at fixed pressure
pressure doubling gives exact doubling for K0, less than doubling and more than sqrt(2) for positive K
sealed branch zero flow and zero enthalpy; unsealed branch flows unchanged by closure at fixed P
same-width active branches equal; all mass fractions sum to one
floor ownership and full-array matrix inherited unchanged; all sealed fluid diffusion connections retained
K monotonic pressure requirements reported only if obtained within domains

resource_plan.optional_dependencies: Existing NumPy and SciPy only; no installs
resource_plan.on_budget: Save all completed and incomplete scenarios with exact reason; stop rather than relax numerical gates

interpretation_and_measurements: Original 25/15 Pa failures and 40g/85C/60W fixed requirements remain intact
A root is zero thermal headroom under a conditional model, not a guaranteed margin
Nominal total P and 40% loss allowance refer to this declared boundary; existing 25 Pa boundary is not silently replaced

Measure branch/system pressure-flow, loss/development coefficients, nominal/fault fan operating point, blockage leakage, thermal contact/base spreading, actual base/hotspots, property variation and total system mass before engineering/aircraft use
